news.title: Why the United States Needs Europe in Order to Win the Technology Race
news.summary_en: Europe is both a vast market and a coproducer of U.S. technology. To outcompete China, the United States must offer allies a stake in building the future rather than exploit their dependencies.

news.title: The Pacific Security Puzzle
news.summary_en: Fierce competition for strategic influence has prompted a proliferation of security-related agreements across the Pacific Islands region in recent years. A new interactive tool from the Australia Chair maps 56 of these arrangements across 14 Pacific countries.

news.title: The Race for Malaysia’s Rare Earths: An Indo-Pacific Strategy
news.summary_en: Malaysia has emerged as a key player in rare earth supply chain diversification, expanding refining and processing capacity outside China. Its rise reflects decades of international cooperation, but future progress will require navigating its close ties with China.

news.title: Missile Diplomacy: North Korea Ramps Up Threats in Trump 2.0
news.summary_en: Amid President Donald Trump’s calls for summitry with his “friend” Kim Jong-un, as well as his observation that Kim has been “unthreatening and respectful," North Korea has not slowed its missile testing spree.

news.title: Space Superiority and the Military Tools to Secure It
news.summary_en: Space superiority requires credible military options to protect U.S. forces and counter adversaries’ use of space. Integrating space control capabilities into joint operations can strengthen deterrence and preserve U.S. advantage.

news.title: 25 Years After the Anthrax Attacks, Reauthorize and Modernize PAHPA to Better Protect Americans
news.summary_en: Today, 25 years after the 2001 anthrax attacks, the biological threat landscape is becoming even riskier. It’s time for Congress to reauthorize and modernize the Pandemic and All Hazards Preparedness Act (PAHPA).
